Over the last 20 years we’ve received some pretty amazing fan art that made us go 😚👌

So, if you’re a Rooster Teeth fan that enjoys making art… this post is for you! Send us over your best RT fan art, whether it’s recent or 20 years old, we would like to see it. 🤲🎨🖌
